label: Reusable lexical graph
failure_mode: Return unavailable or a narrower reviewed result; never synthesize a lexical row merely because the graph is sparse.
invariants: Stable lexical IDs are identity; surface text is not identity.
A form may have multiple analyses and a spelling may have multiple senses or lexemes.
Concept links do not prove exact translation equivalence.
Candidate lexical material cannot present as verified Lexi.
